title: Private Pay Long-Term Care Residency Re-Charge Span: Amount, Days and Entry
content:
**Revenue cycle billing standard, resumed months — Private Pay Long-Term Care Residency.** The re-charge span is figured on the agreement's advance charge whose span begins latest (the one posted first where two begin on the same day), on an agreement that is active again.

**Amount.** The re-charge span equals the re-charge days less the re-charge leave days that fall on or after the first re-charged day and on or before the last re-charge day, never below zero, times the re-charge rate, rounded half up to the cent once, on the final figure; where it is zero no span is posted.

**Rate.** The re-charge rate is the daily rate of the re-charge tier under the re-charge schedule.

**Days.** The re-charge days run from the first re-charged day through the last day of the advance's span, or through the day before a move to another tier the agreement records on or after its conversion date inside that span, the new room's span charging the later days, and they count only where the advance carries a payer-conversion credit; where it carries none, the advance still bills those days and no day is re-charged. The first re-charged day is the conversion date recorded on the agreement when private-pay billing resumed, and the re-charge days count that day and every later day of the span.

**Entry.** The span is entered for the advance's service month, from the first re-charged day through the last re-charge day, at the re-charge rate, for the re-charge tier, with the re-charge days less the re-charge leave days as its day count and with the standard charge basis.

**Other terms.** The re-charge leave days are none. The re-charge tier is the tier the advance was posted for. The re-charge schedule is the one in effect for the agreement on the first day of the advance's span: the current private pay schedule once the agreement's rate notice had run the rate change notice days by that day and the span begins on or after the current schedule's effective date, 1 July 2026, and the preceding schedule otherwise.

| Accommodation tier | Preceding schedule (effective 1 July 2025), USD per day | Current schedule (effective 1 July 2026), USD per day |
|---|---|---|
| Semi-Private Long-Term Care Room | 384.00 | 398.00 |
| Semi-Private Secure Memory Care Room | 412.00 | 427.00 |
| Private Long-Term Care Room | 421.00 | 436.00 |
| Private Secure Memory Care Room | 449.00 | 465.00 |
| Private Bariatric Care Room | 466.00 | 482.00 |
| Private Suite with Sitting Area | 497.00 | 514.00 |

**Hypothetical worked example (figures invented).** A 31-day advance carrying a payer-conversion credit; private billing resumed on its 22nd day; no move. Re-charge days 22 to 31, 10 days; for an advance posted for the Private Secure Memory Care Room under the preceding schedule, 10 times 449.00, 4,490.00, entered from day 22 to day 31 with a day count of 10. The same advance without a payer-conversion credit: no day is re-charged.
